field.description: Multipart form field name for this file.
field.title: Field

file.description: The file to upload (a platform file or an http(s) URL).
file.title: File

filename.description: Filename sent in the part. Defaults to the file's own name.
filename.title: Filename

content_type.description: Content-Type of the part. Defaults to the file's detected type.
content_type.title: Content Type

url.description: Request URL. http or https only; must resolve to a public internet address.
url.title: Url

headers.description: Request headers. Connection-level headers (Host, Content-Length, Connection, Transfer-Encoding, ...) are dropped.
headers.title: Headers

query.description: Query parameters, added to any already in the URL. A list repeats the key.
query.title: Query

body_json.description: JSON request body (any JSON value). Sets Content-Type: application/json.
body_json.title: Body Json

body_text.description: Raw text request body. Set Content-Type in headers (default text/plain; charset=utf-8).
body_text.title: Body Text

form.description: Form fields. Sent application/x-www-form-urlencoded, or as multipart fields when files are given.
form.title: Form

files.description: Files to upload as multipart/form-data, optionally with form fields.
files.title: Files

timeout_seconds.description: Deadline for the whole request: connect, redirects and reading the body.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

follow_redirects.description: Follow 3xx redirects. Each hop is checked like the first.
follow_redirects.title: Follow Redirects

max_response_bytes.description: Largest response body to read (decoded bytes).
max_response_bytes.title: Max Response Bytes

truncate.description: When the body exceeds max_response_bytes: true returns the first max_response_bytes with truncated=true, false fails the task.
truncate.title: Truncate

response_as.description: auto: JSON to body_json, small text to body_text, anything else to body_file. json/text/file force one.
response_as.title: Response As
